question: Calculate: \(70-26=?\)
solution: Subtracting 6 from 0 requires borrowing. Exchange 1 ten for 10 ones, changing 70 from 7 tens and 0 ones to 6 tens and 10 ones. Subtracting 26 leaves \(10-6=4\) ones and \(6-2=4\) tens. \(70-26=44\).
